MRI Safety Information
The Pylon Aneurysm Clip is MR Conditional. A person with the Pylon Aneurysm Clip may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Pylon Aneurysm Clip
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 3T only
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 1000 gauss/cm
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1 W/kg
Maximum Head SAR 0.4 W/kg
Scan Duration Maximum active scan time of 30 minutes.
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 5 mm from the device.
